questions.section: Questions for consumers of packaged takeaway liquor and/or on-premises hospitality services in Roma
questions.text: Describe the factors that you consider most important, or you value the most, when choosing which bottle shop/business to purchase packaged takeaway liquor from. In your response, identify the degree to which you frequently ‘shop around’ to find the ‘best deal’ based on your purchasing needs. For example, the factors you consider most important could include the range of products, product prices, loyalty programs and promotions, service quality, whether the bottle shop is located near a pub, opening hours, brand of bottle shop etc.
